entries.title: Psalms 131:1
segments: ¶<A Song of the going up. Of David.> Lord, there is no pride in my heart and my eyes are not lifted up; and I have not taken part in great undertakings, or in things over-hard for me.

entries.title: Psalms 131:2
segments: See, I have made my soul calm and quiet, like a child on its mother's breast; my soul is like a child on its mother's breast.

entries.title: Psalms 131:3
segments: O Israel, have hope in the Lord, from this time and for ever.
